value.rationale: A natural finite network reliability design asks how to place four scarce uncertain backup links. The all-length theorem exhibits a non-obvious change from even spacing to double endpoint clusters under imperfection, proves that four is the first possible link count, and gives an exact double-scaling phase threshold and all-size optimizer formula rather than an isolated computation.
